When: This Saturday, May 23rd, from 10 to 11:30 AM  
Where: 2800 N 14th St, St. Louis, MO 63107
RSVP Here:
mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

SATURDAY MAY 23RD:

Join Cori Bush for coffee and conversation on Saturday!

Come talk with Cori and community members about the issues affecting our neighbors and support a local Black-owned business at the same time!

We’ll meet at The Daily Drip Coffee Cafe and invite St. Louisans to share your ideas for shaping our future together.
RSVP HERE: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

Avengers of Democracy unite!

Join Cori Bush, Jamal Bowman, Imani Bashir, Noura Erakart, and Bassam Haddad to build a movement that answers to everyday people, not billionaires.

Together, we are rallying to raise funds and take on the Big Pharma, ICE contractors, and war profiteers who are already gearing up to back politicians who won’t stand up to Trump’s MAGA agenda.

We need people-powered organizing to fight big money to win.

I am heartbroken and horrified by the shooting that took place today at the Islamic Center of San Diego.

This targeting of a place of worship cannot be separated from decades of hateful, dehumanizing, Islamophobic rhetoric that fuels senseless violence.

My prayers are with the families of the victims, the San Diego Muslim community, and everyone who is feeling pain and fear in the wake of this tragedy.

It was a beautiful day in St. Louis at Annie Malone’s May Day Festival!

I’m always proud to join local businesses, organizations, and community members in supporting Annie Malone Children & Family Services and the work they do to support STL’s children and families in crisis.

Thank you so much to everyone who joined us on the old Save-A-Lot parking lot in North City today to provide relief, resources, and food for our neighbors whose lives were upended by last year’s tornado.

For the past 12 months, our community has shown up for each other in incredible ways. But we are still so far from the full recovery that we desperately need.

St. Louis deserves more than this. I’m committed to making sure that our communities receive not only the federal funds we need to rebu

A full year after a tornado devastated our community, it’s clear that the relief, recovery, and rebuilding effort has been a complete failure.

St. Louis deserves a Representative who will stand up for us and fight for the federal recovery funding that we deserve.

Video

It's been a full year since an EF-3 tornado devastated St. Louis and destroyed homes, schools, and businesses.

As we mourn the lives that were lost that day and reflect on the ways that the Northside has been changed forever, we also celebrate the resilience of our community and the 12 months of tireless work that our neighbors have done to rebuild and recover.

But they can’t continue to do it all alone. That’s why I’m joining our community in demanding that our local officials allocate $150 m

I’ll always speak out against genocide, especially when our own tax dollars fund the weapons that are being used to kill the Palestinian people, tear families apart, and destroy homes, hospitals, and places of worship.

Today and every day, we call for the recognition of Palestinian refugees’ right to return, an end to apartheid, and for the liberation and self-determination of all people.

The Nakba didn’t end in 1948. It continues to this day as Netanyahu’s government annexes Palestinian land and allows illegal settlements in the West Bank, and as Israeli forces commit genocide in Gaza with the full support of our own government.

Catastrophe; that’s what Nakba means. And for Palestinians, this catastrophe has been ongoing for 78 years.

Today marks the 78th commemoration of the Nakba. We take today to remember the ethnic cleansing of over 750,000 Palestinians and the destruction of more than 500 towns in Palestine in 1948.

TODAY:

Join us for Conversations with Cori in the park!

This Thursday, we'll be at Forest Park talking with community members about the challenges STL faces and how we’ll work together to solve them from 4:00 pm to 5:30 pm.

Join us this afternoon (5/14) at:
5700 Lindell Blvd, East of the Missouri History Museum

Video

I’m running for Congress to fight back against Donald Trump, the white supremacist in chief.

That’s why last cycle, MAGA lobbies like AIPAC spent millions against me. This time, they're backing my opponent again to try to stop our movement.

Big money has no place in our elections. I’m proud to be running a campaign backed by everyday people, not billionaires.

Video

TOMORROW:

Let’s get to know each other!

Conversations with Cori is a time to talk about what’s important to us, the issues St. Louis faces, and how we’ll shape our community’s future.

Join us in Forest Park!

🗓️ May 14th, 4:00 - 5:30 PM

📍 5700 Lindell Blvd, East of the Missouri History Museum

I was so glad to attend the Penrose Neighborhood Community Association and O’Fallon Community Developing Organization’s joint meeting to discuss what our communities need to rebuild and recover after last year’s tornado.

I was also proud to present awards to small businesses for their leadership and community service.

Together, we’ll make sure that North City can thrive as we protect, build and transform St. Louis.

The nuclear contamination that plagues the area around Coldwater Creek is yet another example of how environmental racism deeply affects Black communities.

In Congress, I made sure we extended and expanded RECA for those who suffer long-term illnesses or lost loved ones as a result of the contamination.

I’m ready to go back to ensure that the decontamination effort is safe, efficient, and puts the needs of the families who are most affected first.

If you know me, you know I'm always ten toes down for St. Louis. It's why I delivered record federal funding to STL while in office.

It's also why I've spoken out against the historic disinvestment of North STL and the state takeover of our police.

Our Black and brown communities have been the target of the Republican-led state legislature for far too long.

St. Louis has the right to govern itself, and we deserve leaders who will fight to protect that right.

Video

It was inspiring to join SEIU AFRAM’s community drive yesterday and see how they’re continuing the work to provide for our neighbors after last year's tornado.

I’m running to go back to Congress to keep fighting for the Northside and to make sure that STL gets the true recovery and relief it deserves.

Happy Mother’s Day, St. Louis!

This year, I’m reminded of all the moms in Missouri and around the country who we’re fighting for to deliver quality education, safer communities, and universal childcare.

Today and every day, we celebrate mothers by committing to building a future where all families have their basic needs guaranteed.

I’m wishing a very happy Mother’s Day to my mom and to moms everywhere.
